title: Timescale Limits of Linear-Threshold Networks
summary: Linear-threshold networks (LTNs) capture the mesoscale behavior of interacting populations of neurons and are of particular interest to control theorists due to their dynamical richness and relative ease of analysis. The aim of this paper is to advance the study of global asymptotic stability in LTNs with asymmetric neural interactions and heterogeneous dissipation under the structural Lyapunov diagonal stability (LDS) condition.
